name: Kerala Aawaz Migrant Health Insurance Scheme
authority: Government of Kerala • Department of Labour & Skills
infoBlurb: Universal free healthcare and accidental death insurance for all registered inter-state guest workers working in Kerala. Includes free consultations, diagnostics, and essential medications across empaneled government hospitals.
benefits: ₹25,000 annual inpatient medical care at all Kerala Taluk & District Government Hospitals.
₹2,00,000 accidental death & total permanent disability insurance cover.
100% free biometric smart card linked directly to your Portable Health ID.
Cashless diagnostic tests, x-rays, and prescription pharmacy benefits.
howToApply: Present your Athidhi Swasthya Passport / Portable Health ID at any Kerala Taluk Hospital or Akshaya Centre.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (ABHA / National Health Cover)
malayalamName: ആയുഷ്മാൻ ഭാരത് പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ജൻ ആരോഗ്യ യോജന (PM-JAY)
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
bengaliName: আয়ুষ্মান ভারত প্রধানমন্ত্রী জন আরোগ্য যোজনা (PM-JAY)
odiaName: ଆୟୁଷ୍ମାନ ଭାରତ ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଜନ ଆରୋଗ୍ୟ ଯୋଜନା (PM-JAY)
authority: National Health Authority (NHA) • Government of India
infoBlurb: Flagship national health insurance scheme providing ₹5 Lakh cashless coverage per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across 28,000+ empaneled public & private hospitals pan-India.
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization in 28,000+ empaneled hospitals across India.
Covers 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses.
Universal national portability — valid in your home state and your Kerala worksite.
Zero out-of-pocket expense for surgeries, ICU, dialysis, and oncology treatments.
howToApply: Link your ABHA ID (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) with your Athidhi Swasthya Passport at any PHC.

name: Employees' State Insurance (ESIC Medical & Social Security)
authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment • ESIC India
coverageAmount: Full Medical Care + 70% Sickness Cash Benefit
infoBlurb: Comprehensive integrated social security scheme providing complete medical care to factory, construction, and mill workers along with cash compensation during sickness, temporary disablement, or workplace injuries.
benefits: Unlimited medical treatment at ESIC dispensaries and superspecialty hospitals without upper ceiling.
70% daily wage cash compensation during certified sickness up to 91 days per year.
Workplace injury & occupational rehabilitation allowances.
Dependent family members covered for outpatient and inpatient hospital care.
howToApply: Obtain an ESI Pehchan Card through your employer or contractor registered with ESIC Kerala.

name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP Kerala)
authority: State Health Agency (SHA) • Government of Kerala
infoBlurb: Kerala state-sponsored health protection umbrella designed for vulnerable workers requiring high-cost medical care for cardiac, pulmonary, renal, and chronic occupational illnesses.
benefits: Fast-track referral to Kerala Government Medical College Hospitals (Ernakulam, Kozhikode, Trivandrum).
Full coverage for advanced pulmonary diagnostics, CT scans, and chronic medication protocols.
Emergency financial assistance up to ₹5,00,000 for critical surgeries.
Priority doctor triage for workers flagged with Red or Yellow risk status.
howToApply: Automatically verified at Kerala CHCs/District Hospitals upon referral by the consulting doctor.

name: Kerala Migrant Workers Welfare Board (KMWWB Benefits)
hindiName: केरल प्रवासी श्रमिक कल्याण बोर्ड योजना
bengaliName: কেরল পরিযায়ী শ্রমিক কল্যাণ বোর্ড প্রকল্প
odiaName: କେରଳ ପ୍ରବାସୀ ଶ୍ରମିକ କଲ୍ୟାଣ ବୋର୍ଡ ଯୋଜନା
authority: Kerala Inter-State Migrant Workers Welfare Scheme
infoBlurb: Dedicated welfare fund providing direct cash grants for healthcare emergencies, marriage assistance, maternity allowances, children educational stipends, and retirement pension for guest workers.
benefits: ₹10,000 medical emergency grant for hospitalization exceeding 10 days.
₹10,000 marriage assistance for worker or daughter's marriage.
₹2,000/month retirement pension for members completing 60 years of age.
Annual educational scholarships up to ₹5,000 for school-going children.
howToApply: Register membership with the Kerala Labour Welfare Office at your district headquarters.
